content: chokidar (and fs.watch generally) has known event-storm and resource-scaling problems: CPU/memory grow with total watched file count (not just changes), duplicate/double change events are emitted for single writes, and EMFILE errors occur when watching too many directories (git repos with node_modules, .git internals under heavy commit activity are classic triggers). Recommendation: watch narrowly (only .planning/**), ignore .git internals except relevant refs, debounce/coalesce events, and avoid recursive watch on huge trees.
